source_note: Nicaragua's largest fast-food chain (40 locations nationwide, founded 1958). Real combo names + real córdoba prices pulled from press coverage and social listings -- the chain's own official site (restaurantestiptop.com / tiptoprestaurantes.com) had persistent connectivity/certificate errors across multiple direct-fetch attempts and couldn't be read directly. Combos are family-size (8-12 chicken pieces); nutrition estimated per a 2-piece individual portion, not the whole combo. No second real Nicaraguan chain found that clears the multi-location bar (KFC/Church's/Pollo Campero present in-market are international, not local). No official nutrition data published; AI-estimated.
